questions.q: A customer asks for a cushion re-covering quote of exactly $350. May the assistant approve it on its own?
A cushion re-covering quote comes to $351. May the assistant approve it on its own, and if not, who must approve?
questions.gold: no, Marta Quill (workshop manager) must approve

questions.q: A full sofa reupholstery quote comes to only $200. May the assistant approve it on its own, and if not, who approves?
questions.gold: no — the $350 limit applies only to cushion re-covering; Marta Quill, the workshop manager, must approve

questions.q: A customer asks for price matching. Who may agree to it?
Un client signale une odeur de brûlé provenant d'un fauteuil chauffant révisé par l'atelier. Quel numéro l'assistant doit-il appeler lui-même, et que doit faire le client lui-même ?
questions.gold: the assistant calls 555-0147 itself (and tells the customer a technician is on the way); the customer must unplug the recliner himself and keep everyone away from it

questions.q: A trade customer with an active account places an order. Must they pay a deposit before work starts?
A regular (non-trade) customer places an order of $1,200. How much deposit is required before work starts?
未払いの請求書について、アシスタントが Paul Finch に連絡してもよいですか？
When and to whom is the weekly summary of open quotes sent?
questions.gold: every Friday at 16:00 (4 pm), to Marta Quill

questions.q: How must every quote end?
questions.gold: with the sentence "Prices are valid for 14 days from the date of this quote."

questions.q: What are the library's opening hours on December 27?
12月3日に借りた紙芝居の返却期限はいつですか？
12月10日に借りた雑誌の返却期限も1月12日に延長されますか？
questions.gold: no — the extension only covers magazines borrowed on or after December 15; it is due two weeks after borrowing (December 24)

questions.q: May a DVD be returned through the book drop on December 29?
questions.gold: no, CDs and DVDs must be returned at the counter

questions.q: On which dates is the book drop closed?
リサイクル市で本を7冊買うと、いくらになりますか？
Who is the contact person for inquiries, and what is the phone number?
休館期間中、1月4日に2階学習室を利用できるのは誰で、何時から何時までですか？
questions.gold: only exam candidates (students preparing for entrance exams, with student ID), 13:00–17:00 (1–5 pm)

questions.q: When does the library reopen after the closure, and at what time?
A custom piece quote comes to exactly 250 €. May the assistant accept it alone?
120 €'luk bir özel ders (cours privé) talebini asistan kendi başına onaylayabilir mi? Onaylayamıyorsa kim onaylar?
questions.gold: no — the 250 € limit applies only to custom pieces; Sophie Laurent (the manager) must approve every private lesson

questions.q: A client asks to move their course booking for the third time. May the assistant do it alone, and if not, whose agreement is needed?
questions.gold: no, Sophie Laurent's agreement is needed

questions.q: Peut-on transférer une question de facturation à Hugo Ménard ?
What is Hugo Ménard's role?
窯室でガスの臭いがすると生徒から報告がありました。アシスタントは自分でどの番号に電話し、生徒自身は何をしなければなりませんか？
questions.gold: the assistant itself calls the gas emergency service at 01 84 62 37 90 and tells the student help is coming; the student must leave the building immediately himself without touching the switches

questions.q: Un élève annule 30 heures avant son cours et présente un certificat médical. Est-il remboursé ?
Peut-on contacter Bernard Roux au sujet d'une réclamation client ?
With what exact sentence must every course confirmation start?
questions.gold: « Merci de votre confiance, l'équipe Terre & Feu. »

questions.q: Within how long must a custom piece request receive a reply?
Müşteri keşif tarihinden 5 gün önce iptal ediyor. Kaç TL iade edilir?
A customer cancels the site survey 2 days before the survey date. How much is refunded?
questions.gold: nothing (0 TL) — the 75% refund needs at least 3 days' notice

questions.q: Pour un contrat d'installation de 45 000 TL, quel est le montant de l'acompte (kapora) ?
May the assistant give a 500 TL discount on a maintenance visit on its own?
Asistan bir bakım ziyaretinde kendi başına 600 TL indirim verebilir mi? Veremezse kimin onayı gerekir?
questions.gold: no, Emre Kaya (technical manager) must approve

questions.q: A customer wants to negotiate the price. Should the assistant forward this to Selin Aydın?
questions.gold: no — she is the accounting manager, not the sales manager

questions.q: A customer reports sparks coming from the inverter. Which number does the assistant call itself, and what must the customer do themselves?
questions.gold: the assistant calls 0212 555 47 80 itself and tells the customer a technician is on the way; the customer must switch off the DC isolator themselves and stay away from the inverter

questions.q: 2020年に設置した顧客が、元の請求書なしで保証申請をしてきました。請求書を求めるべきですか？
questions.gold: no — invoices for installations before 2022 are already in the system

questions.q: May the assistant add Murat Demir as a CC on an email about a warranty claim?
When and to whom is the weekly summary of open warranty claims sent?
questions.gold: every Thursday at 17:00 (5 pm), to Emre Kaya
